fields.headline: Correction: video of the plant fire was filmed in 2022
fields.original: A web article and a push alert published at 5:42 PM ET on November 4.
fields.wasWrong: The article said a video showed a fire at the Halyard Components plant on Tuesday.
fields.isRight: The video was filmed at a different facility in 2022. There was no fire at the plant on Tuesday.
fields.actionTaken: The video was removed from the article, the push alert was withdrawn and the article was updated.

fields.headline: Retraction: our report on the plant fire is withdrawn
fields.actionTaken: The article was withdrawn in full and replaced with this notice.
